name: Analyzing Brain Signals For Cognitive States
model: Bandpower Spectral Featurizer + Support Vector Machine
description: Brain-computer interface research module extracting theta/alpha/beta frequency bandpowers from EEG channels to classify cognitive focus.
limitations: EEG leads capture substantial electromyographic muscle movement and ocular blink noise artifacts.
responsible_use_notes: RESEARCH ONLY: Strictly for exploratory BCI studies. Do not claim clinical diagnostic validity for neurological disorders.
